rows.vgi.doc_llm: Every CSS named color the worker knows, each paired with its lowercase '#rrggbb' sRGB hex value. Query it to discover valid CSS color names, to map a name to its hex value, or as the reference table behind nearest_color_name. One row per color.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
# named_colors

The discovery table of every CSS Color Module Level 4 named color. One row per color, with columns `name` (the color name, e.g. `tomato`) and `hex` (its lowercase `#rrggbb` sRGB value). Use it to list valid color names, look up a name's hex value, or browse the palette that backs `nearest_color_name`.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the first few CSS named colors with their hex values.","sql":"SELECT name, hex FROM color.main.named_colors ORDER BY name LIMIT 5"},{"description":"Look up the hex value of a specific CSS named color.","sql":"SELECT hex FROM color.main.named_colors WHERE name = 'tomato'"},{"description":"Which CSS named colors are safe for body text on a white page? Grade every named color as text on #ffffff with contrast_ratio and wcag_level, keep AA or better, and list the six lightest that still pass, starting with teal (4.77:1). Only 32 of the 148 names pass; most fail.","sql":"SELECT n.name, n.hex, ROUND(color.main.contrast_ratio(n.hex, '#ffffff'), 2) AS ratio, color.main.wcag_level(n.hex, '#ffffff') AS level FROM color.main.named_colors AS n WHERE color.main.wcag_level(n.hex, '#ffffff') IN ('AA', 'AAA') ORDER BY ratio, n.name LIMIT 6"},{"description":"Palette de-duplication: join named_colors to itself, score every pair of names with different hex values by CIEDE2000 delta_e, and keep the pairs a viewer can barely tell apart (ΔE00 < 2). Five pairs qualify, from chartreuse / lawngreen (0.652) to moccasin / wheat (1.99).","sql":"SELECT name_a, name_b, hex_a, hex_b, ROUND(d, 3) AS delta_e FROM (SELECT a.name AS name_a, b.name AS name_b, a.hex AS hex_a, b.hex AS hex_b, color.main.delta_e(a.hex, b.hex) AS d FROM color.main.named_colors AS a JOIN color.main.named_colors AS b ON a.name < b.name AND a.hex <> b.hex) AS pairs WHERE d < 2 ORDER BY delta_e, name_a, name_b"}]
